name: Dead Reckoning

categories.label: Achievements (coin value on Harbor board)
categories.labelVi: Thành tựu (giá trị coin trên bảng Harbor)
categories.hint: Sum of the coin values printed on the Harbor spaces where your Achievement markers sit.

categories.label: Coins in Treasure chest
categories.hint: All coins in your Treasure chest.

categories.label: Coins on Ship
categories.hint: All coins on your Ship board.

categories.label: Coins on controlled islands
categories.labelVi: Coin trên đảo đang kiểm soát

categories.label: Buildings on controlled islands
categories.labelVi: Công trình trên đảo kiểm soát
categories.hint: 1 coin per Building on islands you control.

categories.label: Basic Ship Upgrades
categories.hint: 1 coin each; covered upgrades still count.

categories.label: Advanced Ship Upgrades
categories.hint: 2 coins each; covered upgrades still count.

categories.label: End-of-game Advancement effects
categories.hint: Total coins from purple-border end-of-game abilities on your Advancements.

categories.label: Advancements owned
categories.hint: 1 coin per 2 Advancements (on cards or set aside), rounded down.

categories.label: Island influence majorities
categories.hint: One entry per island: coins by rank of your cubes (1st=larger number on ocean board, 2nd=second, 3rd where shown). Empty cube spaces count as a rival; ties take next value down, tie for 3rd scores 0.

categories.label: Bonus Achievement token matches
categories.hint: Optional rule: 2 coins per completed Achievement shown on your revealed bonus token.

tiebreakers.description: Tied players count Cannons on Ship and all deck cards, drop that many cubes into the Battle Ship (no Battle abilities); most Battle strength wins, repeat if still tied.

notes: family: engine-building-end-bonuses. Game ends after a player holds 4+ Achievement markers; each other player takes one last turn. Achievement coin values and island rank values are printed on components (not readable from rulebook text), so they are scorer inputs. Pirate/Privateer/Merchant/Explorer strategies score identically. Solo rules and expansions not modelled.

sources.title: Dead Reckoning rulebook (AEG, 2023 revised)
sources.section: pp.22-23 Game End & Scoring; Bonus Achievement tokens
